# UserVoice

> UserVoice is an AI-powered customer feedback and customer intelligence platform for enterprise software teams. It captures feedback from every channel, weighs each request by the revenue and accounts behind it, and helps teams close the loop when work ships.

UserVoice was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in San Francisco. It attaches user, account and revenue data to every idea, uses AI to detect themes, sentiment and urgency, merges duplicate requests, and connects to delivery tools so customers hear back when their requests move forward.

Plans: UserVoice offers three modern plans (Launch, Business and Enterprise), starting at $12,000/yr. Every plan includes the UserVoice agent, UserVoice MCP and the API, unlimited feedback, unlimited portal users and unlimited view-only admins. Only full-access admins count toward a plan. A free 30-day trial is available after a demo.

AI and MCP: the UserVoice agent answers questions about ideas, accounts and users inside the admin console. UserVoice MCP works with AI assistants that support remote MCP servers with OAuth, including Claude, ChatGPT and Codex, using OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.

## Product

- [Customer feedback software](https://uservoice.com/customer-feedback-software): Product overview of the UserVoice platform: portals, tickets, calls, revenue-based prioritization and closing the loop
- [Capture feedback](https://uservoice.com/capture-feedback): Branded feedback portals, in-app feedback and team capture in one structured program
- [Analyze and understand](https://uservoice.com/analyze-and-understand): AI themes, summaries and account context that show what customers mean and what it is worth
- [Take action](https://uservoice.com/take-action): Prioritize by revenue, connect delivery tools and tell customers what shipped
- [UserVoice agent and MCP](https://uservoice.com/ai-mcp): The in-product AI agent and the MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP clients
- [Integrations](https://uservoice.com/integrations): Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Azure DevOps, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zendesk, Gainsight, identity providers and MCP
- [Pricing](https://uservoice.com/pricing): Launch, Business and Enterprise plans compared
- [What's new](https://uservoice.com/product-feed): Recent product updates

## Solutions

- [Customer intelligence platform](https://uservoice.com/customer-intelligence-explained): What customer intelligence is and how UserVoice ranks feedback by revenue
- [Product feedback software](https://uservoice.com/product-feedback-software): Collect, score and act on product feedback
- [Customer feedback portal](https://uservoice.com/customer-feedback-portal): Branded portal where customers submit ideas, vote and track status
- [Feature request management](https://uservoice.com/feature-request-management): Collect, merge and prioritize feature requests by revenue
- [Idea management software](https://uservoice.com/idea-management-software): Idea portals with voting and a path from idea to roadmap
- [Enterprise feedback management](https://uservoice.com/enterprise-feedback-management): Per-unit views, revenue-weighted rollups and procurement-ready security
- [Voice of the customer software](https://uservoice.com/voice-of-the-customer-software): Bring feedback and account data into one story for leadership
- [AI customer feedback analysis](https://uservoice.com/ai-customer-feedback-analysis): Theme clustering, sentiment scoring and revenue ranking
- [Prioritize feedback by revenue](https://uservoice.com/prioritize-feedback): Surface the requests tied to the most revenue
- [Close the loop and build trust](https://uservoice.com/rebuild-customer-trust): Show progress and alert customers when requests ship
- [Align teams internally](https://uservoice.com/align-internally): One source of truth for customer needs across product, success and sales

## Comparisons

- [UserVoice alternatives](https://uservoice.com/alternatives): How UserVoice compares with Pendo, Featurebase, Productboard, Canny and others
- [UserVoice vs Canny](https://uservoice.com/canny-comparison)
- [UserVoice vs Productboard](https://uservoice.com/productboard-comparison)
- [UserVoice vs Aha](https://uservoice.com/aha-comparison)
- [UserVoice vs Pendo](https://uservoice.com/pendo-comparison)
- [UserVoice vs Featurebase](https://uservoice.com/featurebase-comparison)
- [UserVoice vs Frill](https://uservoice.com/frill-comparison)
- [UserVoice vs Savio](https://uservoice.com/savio-comparison)
- [UserVoice vs Enterpret](https://uservoice.com/enterpret-comparison)
- [UserVoice vs Unwrap.ai](https://uservoice.com/unwrap-comparison)

## Trust and security

- [Security and compliance](https://uservoice.com/security-compliance): SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, SSO and SCIM, and OAuth 2.1 with PKCE for AI assistants
- [GDPR compliance](https://uservoice.com/gdpr-compliance): How customer data is collected, processed and protected
- [WCAG compliance](https://uservoice.com/wcag-compliance): Accessibility commitments behind the platform

## Learn

- [UserVoice Answers](https://uservoice.com/answers): Straight answers about the platform, AI, MCP, pricing, integrations, security and fit
- [UserVoice Academy](https://uservoice.com/academy): Free guides on capturing feedback, weighing it by revenue and closing the loop
- [Blog](https://uservoice.com/blog): Product management and customer intelligence articles
- [Help Center](https://help.uservoice.com): Product documentation for admins
- [Developer docs](https://developer.uservoice.com): API reference

## Optional

- [Book a demo](https://uservoice.com/demo)
- [System status](https://status.uservoice.com)
- [Terms of Service](https://uservoice.com/tos)
- [Privacy Policy](https://uservoice.com/privacy)
- [Data Privacy Framework](https://uservoice.com/data-privacy-framework)

<style>
  /* Caret follows the open state, whether opened by Webflow's JS or by hover */
  .nav-dropdown-icon-2 {
    transition: transform 200ms ease;
  }
  .nav-dropdown-toggle-2.w--open .nav-dropdown-icon-2 {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 992px) {
    /* Backstop for the data-hover="true" attribute on each dropdown, so hover
       works even if Webflow's own data-hover wins. Mirrors the padding and
       shadow Webflow applies through .w--open. !important is needed because
       Webflow's dropdown JS writes display inline after a click-close. */
    .nav-dropdown-2:hover .nav-dropdown-list-2 {
      display: block !important;
      padding-top: 5px;
      padding-bottom: 5px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(70, 70, 82, 0.1);
    }
    .nav-dropdown-2:hover .nav-dropdown-icon-2 {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }
  }
</style>

.integration-stack > .integrations-cells:empty { display: none; }

.uv2-role-card > .uvp-038 { order: -1; margin-bottom: 8px; }

@media (min-width: 768px) { #comparison .uvai-thead, #comparison .uvai-tr { grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); } }

@media (min-width: 768px) { #comparison .uvai-tbl:has(.uvai-th:nth-child(6)) .uvai-thead, #comparison .uvai-tbl:has(.uvai-th:nth-child(6)) .uvai-tr { grid-template-columns: 240px repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); } #comparison .uvai-tbl:has(.uvai-th:nth-child(6)) .uvai-td, #comparison .uvai-tbl:has(.uvai-th:nth-child(6)) .uvai-th { padding-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px; } }

@media (min-width: 992px) { .uv2-subcards:has(> :nth-child(9):last-child) { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

/* Mobile nav (2026-11-03): on phones (767px and below) the Solutions dropdown stacks its two columns (the Navbar layout
   kept them side by side down to 480px, so By Use Case ran off the menu), and the menu panel gets a soft shadow so the
   page behind it doesn't read as part of the menu. Tablet (768-991) keeps the floating two-column dropdown. */
@media (max-width: 767px) {

/* Hairline rows: framework stats, dark band cards, pillar expectations grid, SEO dark role cards, outcome capability grid */
.uv2-fw-grid > div { padding: 24px 24px 0 0; }
.uv2-fw-grid > div + div { padding-left: 24px; border-left: 1px solid #46465233; }
.uv2-dark-card + .uv2-dark-card, .inline-div-87 > * + * { padding-left: 32px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
.uvp-045 > div { background: #fff; padding: 32px; margin: 0; }
.uvp-045 > div > * + * { margin-top: 12px; }
@media (max-width: 991px) {
  .uv2-dark-card + .uv2-dark-card, .inline-div-87 > * + * { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; margin-top: 32px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
  .inline-div-87 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .uvo-grid3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  /* An odd last cell spans the row so the grid's grey fill never shows through as an empty cell */
  .uvp-045 > :last-child:nth-child(odd), .uv2-role-grid > :last-child:nth-child(odd), .uvo-grid3 > :last-child:nth-child(odd), .uv2-subcards > :last-child:nth-child(odd) { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) { .uv2-fw-grid > div:nth-child(3) { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; } }
@media (max-width: 479px) { .uvo-grid3 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
